items.statement: Electron-binding outcome and adiabatic affinity for n=0
items.expected: The final answer reports a genuine calculated positive adiabatic electron affinity for the full n=0 composition, establishing exothermic electron attachment in its investigated state/structure domain. Supply the actual affinity in eV and enough state-resolved energy components to recover it; normal termination or a source number alone is insufficient. No exact scalar tolerance is imposed in the existing qualitative acceptance. Full gas-phase PAl12[B(C6F5)3]n, n=0/1/2, has 13/47/81 atoms; neutral electron counts are 171/419/667 and the corresponding anions have one additional electron. AEA=(E+own ZPE)neutral−(E+own ZPE)anion at separately relaxed valid states, free electron zero. Use the lowest supported states in the actual investigated space; a nearer-source higher state cannot replace a known lower state. AEA is not a vertical affinity, LUMO eigenvalue or Gibbs energy.

items.statement: Nature of charge redistribution caused by neutral ligation
items.expected: Explain the electron-density response to binding full neutral PAl12 and neutral BC18F15 fragments across n=1 and 2: the core becomes electron-depleted toward the Lewis-acid ligands, and depletion is greater for two ligands under a consistent population/density definition. Distinguish this neutral-binding redistribution from the density change on adding one electron to an already ligated complex. Use actual geometry and electronic evidence to support the local core–ligand interaction; equivalent density/bonding evidence is eligible without mandatory Hirshfeld or CDA. Fractional partitioned charges are not integer transfer or shell occupation. This final physical interpretation has no separate points for one/two Al–B structure completion or each population analysis.

items.statement: Electronic origin of enhanced electron acceptance
items.expected: Explain the affinity enhancement using actual neutral electronic-state/bonding evidence showing progressively stabilized acceptor levels with ligation and a supported local core–ligand coupling account. Define spin channels and physical orbital correspondence; LUMO energy is an explanatory descriptor, not AEA. Orbital mixing, transition/density analysis or other equivalent evidence may establish the interaction without an author-specific orbital index or CDA workflow. This scores the electronic cause, not a repeated family ordering or four separate source orbital percentages. Mere AEA numbers or asserted Lewis acidity without electronic evidence fail.

items.statement: What the calculated family establishes about shell preservation
items.expected: Draw a specific applicability conclusion from the actual electronic evidence: local neutral charge redistribution, structural retention and selected level/CDA projections can support the ligation explanation without establishing a complete preserved superatomic angular-shell configuration. Identify which shell/state correspondence is actually supported and which remains untested; a genuinely complete shell-resolved calculation may support a stronger statement if its evidence warrants it. Do not infer integer shell occupation from fractional charges or universality across other core shell fillings from the n=0–2 PAl12 subset. This is an evidence-to-shell-inference result, not generic limitations prose or another award for AEA ordering.
